card.name: Engineering tradeoffs: cost and complexity
card.fires_on: Linking words and punctuation in technical engineering prose, right where a design's advantages or drawbacks (cost, complexity, simplicity) are about to be stated. It fires on words like 'This', 'eliminates', 'reduces', commas and 'with' after a comparison.

modes.label: Design benefit or drawback
modes.description: A word right after an engineering approach is described, just before its effect on problems or complexity is stated.
modes.example: employ replication to synchronize that data.<< This>> approach lets you place one or more nodes

modes.label: Cost comparison
modes.description: Punctuation or linking words after a comparison such as 'more expensive', before cost premiums are named.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words about complexity, simplicity, simplification and cost.
card.plain: It marks spots in engineering text where the next words are likely to discuss how complex, simple or costly a design is.
